 LOAD_BATCH {

 NVARCHAR source_file_name

 }

 }

 VARCHAR transaction_status_name
 }

 VARCHAR transaction_channel_name
 }

 VARCHAR currency_name
 }

 REF_COUNTRY {

 }

 OCB_CUSTOMER {

 VARCHAR phone_number
 NVARCHAR email
 }

 }

 DATE date_of_birth
 NVARCHAR nationality
 NVARCHAR occupation
 VARCHAR phone_number
 NVARCHAR email
 DATETIME2 created_at
 }

 ANANSE_WALLET {

 VARCHAR customer_id FK
 BIGINT ocb_customer_id FK
 }

 ANANSE_TRANSACTION {

 NVARCHAR transaction_type
 NVARCHAR transaction_channel
 NVARCHAR transaction_currency
 DATETIME2 transaction_timestamp
 NVARCHAR transaction_location_region
 NVARCHAR transaction_location_town
 VARCHAR device_id
 DECIMAL transaction_amount
 }

 NVARCHAR first_name
 NVARCHAR last_name
 DATE date_of_birth
 NVARCHAR nationality
 NVARCHAR occupation
 VARCHAR phone_number
 NVARCHAR email
 DATETIME2 created_at
 }

 SIKACREDIT_LOAN {

 NVARCHAR disbursement_location_region
 NVARCHAR disbursement_location_town

 DECIMAL principal_amount
 DECIMAL interest_rate
 CHAR loan_currency
 }

 SIKACREDIT_REPAYMENT {
 VARCHAR repayment_id PK
 VARCHAR loan_id FK
 BIGINT ocb_customer_id FK
 DECIMAL repayment_amount
 DATETIME2 repayment_timestamp
 NVARCHAR repayment_location_region
 NVARCHAR repayment_location_town
 }

 OMAN_REMIT_CUSTOMER {
 VARCHAR customer_id PK
 BIGINT ocb_customer_id FK
 NVARCHAR first_name
 NVARCHAR last_name
 DATE date_of_birth
 NVARCHAR nationality
 NVARCHAR occupation
 VARCHAR phone_number
 NVARCHAR email
 DATETIME2 created_at
 }

 OMAN_REMIT_REMITTANCE {

 }
